dailymail/5823.summary: Aaron Howard, 37, was shot dead by his father-and-son neighbors in Abilene, Texas. John Miller, 67, and Michael Miller, 31, were arrested on murder charges. Howard's fiancee, Kara Box, filmed the argument which led to the shooting on her cell phone.

dailymail/5826.summary: Muslims in Australia are asking for two public holidays for their two annual Eid celebrations. The public holiday would fall on the Mondays following Eid Ul-Fitr and Eid Al Adha. The petition says the Muslim community would like more time to celebrate. The Eid-al-FitR is one of only two major festivals in the Islamic faith.

dailymail/5827.summary: Theresa May will be forced to devise an alternative to her Chequers plan after humiliation. She will face her Cabinet on Monday and is unlikely to resign, a source said. But there are concerns others who are less enthusiastic about her blueprint could seek to use the setback to push for it to be abandoned.

dailymail/5829.summary: Six of 10 siblings of an Arizona Republican running for reelection have thrown their weight behind his Democratic challenger. Paul Gosar is a strident Trump supporter who subscribes to far-right views, including being anti-DACA and pro-border wall. Paul is also said to be a birther who believes that financier and Holocaust survivor George Soros collaborated with the Nazis.

dailymail/5833.summary: Nwodim will begin her stint as a featured player on the long-running NBC series beginning in Season 44, which premieres on September 29. She is filling the featured player spot left open after Luke Null left following his Season 43 stint. Nwodin is a Baltimore, Maryland, native who went down the comedy route after graduating from the University of Southern California with a degree in biology.

dailymail/5834.summary: Dr Wilcox said the impact of the disaster could be 'wide-ranging' She said 'real concern' had been expressed for survivors. Asbestos was used in ceilings and cupboards when tower was built in 1974. If inhaled it can cause mesothelioma, a fatal lung disease.

dailymail/5836.summary: The Ambassador Hotel and its Cocoanut Grove nightclub were the site of the Academy Awards six times. The hotel was once the most luxurious venue in Los Angeles and was once called 'the greatest, gaudiest spree in American history' The hotel shut its doors in 1989 and was eventually demolished in the 2000s.

dailymail/5843.summary: The bank currently employs roughly 265,000 workers, and plans to cut its headcount through both attrition and layoffs. The San Francisco-based bank has been under multiple clouds of scandal starting in 2015 when it admitted its employees opened millions of fake bank accounts for customers. Since admitting to the fraudulent accounts Wells has admitted to other scandals, including selling auto insurance to borrowers who did not need it.

dailymail/5844.summary: Thousands of recruits as well as experts from military and security services will make up a new unit. But tensions have already begun to arise as both GCHQ and the Ministry of Defence are vying to command the unit. Recruits will target Islamic State in Syria and Iraq, gangs, people traffickers and paedophile rings from their base.

dailymail/5852.summary: Woolworths has stopped selling sewing needles in a bid to prevent saboteurs using them to spike fruit. The supermarket giant literally pulled the pin following the crises across Australia. More than 100 reports of tampered fruit are being investigated across the nation. The federal government on Thursday rushed tough new penalties for 'food terrorists' through parliament.

dailymail/5858.summary: Storm star Feki was forced off the field with a shoulder injury. The tackle is headed towards one of the most controversial match reviews and possible judiciary case in the modern day era of the game. Slater could face a minimum two week suspension if charged by the NRL Match Review Committee. Even a one match suspension would see Slater miss next Sunday's NRL grand final in Sydney.

dailymail/5867.summary: Médine cancels two gigs at Bataclan, where 90 people died in attack in 2015. Far-right leader Marine Le Pen welcomed cancellation, calling it a victory for victims. Médine blamed unnamed far-right groups for provoking the outcry. He said he would instead hold an event at the Paris Zenith, a bigger concert hall.

dailymail/5868.summary: The hilarious incident was captured on video by Blair Powell. The two women were forced to retreat after running a red light. They lost control of their rental car and it rolled down a hill. Mr Powell shared the video to Facebook where it received over 1000 likes and 800 shares in an hour.

dailymail/5871.summary: Tran Dai Quang died at a military hospital in Hanoi today after 'serious illness' He had been president since April 2016 after more than four decades at the Ministry of Public Security. His last public appearance was at a Politburo meeting of the ruling Communist Party on Wednesday.

dailymail/5896.summary: Double demerit points will come into force next Thursday at midnight in New South Wales and Australian Capital Territory. Police will be targeting people for speeding, drink and drug driving, mobile phone use, running red lights and set belt offences. Road safety minister Michelle Roberts has urged caution ahead of the Queen's Birthday weekend.

dailymail/5898.summary: The extraction was scheduled for Christmas Eve 2017 and was to be overseen by the head of Ecuador's intelligence agency who arrived in London on 15 December, it was claimed. The plot was allegedly arranged in discussions between Russian diplomats and Fidel Narváez, Ecuador's London consul who is close to Assange. Narvás denies being part of any plot.

dailymail/5900.summary: Garrett Gee and wife Jessica have bought a home in Hawaii to raise their three children Dorothy, five, Manilla, four, and seven-month old Calihan. The family-of-five have visited more than 60 countries together after Garrett sold his mobile-scanning app to Snapchat for $54million in 2015. The parents, originally of Utah, have revealed the toll traveling consistently has begun to take on their children.

dailymail/5901.summary: Customers complained of queues and difficulties checking in at Heathrow. The airline said 'some of its flights were slightly delayed' Broadcaster Andrew Neil was among those caught up in the problems. He tweeted: 'Yet another computer failure at Terminal 5 Heathrow for British Airways. Now regular occurrence. Flights delayed'

dailymail/5905.summary: Melbourne's population increased by 2. 5 per cent annually between 2011 and 2017. The city now has more than 5 million people, with Sydney at 2. 2 per cent. Perth has a slight increase compared to during the mining boom at 0. 98 per cent, while Adelaide's population growth is at 0,068 per cent in 2017.

dailymail/5907.summary: Shannon Rich, 22, ordered two vegetarian Roma pizzas from Domino's. She claims she was so hungry she ate two slices before making the discovery. The university student says the horrific discovery has left her 'paranoid' She says she now checks every single thing she eats to make sure there's no hidden meat in it.

dailymail/5909.summary: Charles and Matthew Truman attacked taxi with 17-inch machete. Charles Truman smashed roof and windows with the blade in Chester. Witness described it as 'like something out of Lord of the Rings' The brothers, of Christleton, Chester, admitted affray and possession of a knife. They were each jailed for two years at Chester Crown Court yesterday.

dailymail/5920.summary: Gang of men target people who are distracted - including sleeping, kissing or drunk. They use one gang member to divert their attention before the theft takes place. In one video, a group of men pretend to make friends with an intoxicated man. They then pull his phone from his pocket before wandering away with it.

dailymail/5929.summary: Olivia, Amelia, Isla, Ava and Emily were the top five names for girls in 2017. Edith has returned to popularity after 84 years out in the cold. Muhammad was the 12th most popular name given to baby boys in 2015. Mohammed and Mohammad were in the top 100 as well – standing at 29 and 68 respectively.

dailymail/5931.summary: Mr Peston accidentally drops his earpiece and utters expletive live on air from Downing Street. The presenter apologises and quickly goes to pick up the device. But as he comes back up, he drops it again and says: 'S***!'

dailymail/5932.summary: Duke and Duchess of Sussex were greeted by chiefs in a traditional ceremony in Albert Park. Harry and Meghan were given a roast pig and a whale's tooth as they were presented with gifts. The couple were given kava, a drink made from a mashed plant root in the yaqona vakaturaga. The royal couple were greeted in the traditional tama, or 'a bit of blessing' as the master of ceremonies put it.

dailymail/5942.summary: Cody Wilson, 30, was arrested in Taipei, Taiwan, on Friday. He is accused of having sex with an underage girl in exchange for money. Wilson is the owner of Defense Distributed, which makes blueprints for untraceable 3D printed guns.

dailymail/5943.summary: Rene Herrera, 39, was shot dead, and fellow gang member Fernando Cruz, 18, was injured and is in critical condition. A third suspected gang member, 18-year-old Hector Martinez, was booked on suspicion of attempted murder. Two officers were injured in the shootout; one was hit in the upper torso and has already been released from the hospital, the other deputy, who was shot in the jaw, remained hospitalized and was expected to survive. Three other deputies and another sheriff's employee on a ride-along in one of the patrol cars as part of her training were uninjured. dailymail/5945.summary: Gang of balaclava wearing raiders scaled the side of the family home in Great Tew. Police were called to the couple's £6 million home in Oxfordshire last Friday. CCTV shows the trio using a ladder to look into the windows of the upstairs. David and Victoria Beckham have been forced to significantly increase security.

dailymail/5947.summary: Deborah Orr, 55, laid bare their private battle on Twitter. She said her husband Will Self, 56, was demanding access to his former home. He is also accused of 'mental cruelty and adultery' in the divorce battle. Ms Orr said he was putting stickers on 'his' belongings in the house. She also revealed he refused to co-operate with her legal team.

dailymail/5959.summary: A couple's dream home has been snatched away from them because of a legal loophole. The 'sunset clause' allows developers to take the property from them. The couple are still fighting to overturn the developer's decision. They cannot challenge the developer in court because of Victoria's current regulations.

dailymail/5973.summary: Jake Parsons, 24, was due to move into a £130,000 flat in Coventry. He had saved for a deposit and planned to pay the money via Barclays. But the bank's online and telephone systems collapsed on Thursday. Mr Parsons was unable to pay money out-of-branch. As a result, Barclays did not pay the solicitor fees to go ahead with the purchase.

dailymail/5989.summary: Ukip leader says he is 'really upset' over the propsects of the party he once led. Comes as party members are set to debate letting Tommy Robinson in. Mr Batten said he backs a hugely controversial motion to let Robinson in the party. He said the activist could help the party broaden its appeal - particularly to voters in the north.

dailymail/5990.summary: Man is seen pacing towards victim before laying him out with a Jackie Chan-style kick. The eight-second clip has racked up more than 275,000 views on Facebook. Police are investigating the attack after the clip went viral on social media. Incident is believed to have taken place outside Poundland in Truro.

dailymail/5995.summary: The man is seen dangling from a bridge which hovers over a busy intersection in Raipur, India. Police officer is seen using a makeshift wooden ladder and his own upper body strength to lift himself over the metal bars. The man is then carefully guided down the long narrow wooden ladder by more men who come to assist.

dailymail/5996.summary: Michael Watson was dragged 150 yards down the road by ammonia-wielding thugs. The 53-year-old was left with flashbacks and seizures after the attack. He was partially disabled after suffering a near-fatal brain injury in 1991. Paul Samuels, 29, and Simon Luck, 31, were jailed for 150 years today. Anselm Legemah, 23, was also jailed for a total of 16 years.
